findings.suggested_fix: Cite the product test lines directly, e.g. sample-system:web/src/__tests__/DoctorDetailPage.test.tsx#L19 and #L24.
findings.text: C6 cites test-strategy#gaps for 'a stubbed fetch and a MemoryRouter', but that section only lists DoctorDetailPage.test.tsx as a source and does not describe the pattern. The claim is true in product code, but its cite does not show it.

switching from doctor A to doctor B shows ₹500.00 and drops ₹1,500.00, on the same page

findings.suggested_fix: Choose a patient or type a reason before changing the doctor, then assert it is still there after doctor B's fee shows.
findings.text: S-2 AC1 requires that the page did not reload. The test names this ('without a reload') but asserts only the fee text. It never checks, for example, that form state such as a chosen patient survives the doctor change.

rubric_items.reason: The only changed file, BookAppointmentPage, has its fee path, URL prefill, stale-data guard, error path and unchanged booking body tested; every AC of S-1 to S-4 maps to a named test.

Most assertions check exact rendered text, the exact POST body and disabled states. A few are weaker: S-2 AC1 'did not reload' is only in the test name, and REQ-12 checks only that fields exist, not that they still work.
Covers a 500 on the fee load with booking still working, a held-then-failing load for doctor B, 0 paise, lakh grouping, a day with no slots, and booked and past slots.

Uses Vitest, jsdom and Testing Library in web/src/__tests__ with a stubbed fetch and MemoryRouter, the same pattern as the existing page tests. Test names follow the HMS-n REQ-n prefix used in the repo.
Reports no numbers of its own and leaves results to the verifier. The coverage skip matches checks.json (coverage status skip, exit 78).
